intro: A weathered man sits beside a case of glittering stones, watching your party with narrowed eyes.
speaker: Stone Merchant
introDialogue: Well now. I've watched a thousand trainers pass this road, swapping partners like worn boots.$But you... these are the same souls you set out with. Every one of them.$Loyalty like that deserves something from my private case. Take a look — but choose carefully. These stones don't come off.
title: The Stone Merchant
description: The merchant's private case holds mega stones that bond with ANY Pokémon — granting the mega's stat gains, its typing, and its ability. A stone given to its true species simply lets it mega evolve. One stone, one recipient, no returns.

1.label: Browse the Stones
1.tooltip:
(+) Choose one of the merchant's stones and its recipient
(-) The bond is permanent
1.selected: A fine eye. The stone knows its new master already.

2.label: Politely Decline
2.selected: Hmph. Loyalty without ambition. A rarer thing still.

outro: The merchant snaps his case shut and tips his hat. "Treat them well. All of them."
